patterns.message: components/** cannot import from scripts/, catalog/, specimen/, or test/. Move shared logic or types into lib/ or types/, or pass deck and fixture data into the component via props. Do not silence with oxlint-disable.

lib/** cannot import from components/ or @hackersandwizards/slides/lib/slide-components. Keep UI-independent logic in lib/, move component rendering or mapping into components/ (such as components/slide-components.ts), or accept a component/callback parameter. Do not silence with oxlint-disable.

lib/** cannot import from scripts/, catalog/, specimen/, or test/. Move shared pure logic, constants, or types into lib/ or types/ so scripts/, catalog/, specimen/, and test/ import from lib/. Do not silence with oxlint-disable.

types/** cannot import runtime values from lib/ or components/. Switch to a type-only import (`import type { ... }`), or move runtime helpers and constants into lib/ or components/. Do not silence with oxlint-disable.

types/** cannot import from scripts/, catalog/, specimen/, or test/. Declare shared type definitions in types/ (such as types/slide.ts) and import them from scripts/, catalog/, specimen/, or test/. Do not silence with oxlint-disable.

scripts/** cannot import from catalog/ (only scripts/usage.ts may import catalog/guidance). Move shared data or helpers out of catalog/ into lib/ or scripts/ so both scripts/ and catalog/ import them there. Do not silence with oxlint-disable.

scripts/usage.ts may only import catalog/guidance from catalog/. Change the import to catalog/guidance, or move any other shared code out of catalog/ into lib/ or scripts/. Do not silence with oxlint-disable.
